label: lem2.1
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem2.1}
There exists $T_\epsilon^{\max} \in (0, \infty]$ such that the regularized system \eqref{2.1} has a unique nonnegative solution $(u_\epsilon, w_\epsilon) \in (W_p^{2,1}(Q_T))^2$. Moreover, if $T_\epsilon^{\max} < \infty$, then $\lim_{t \to T_\epsilon^{\max}} (\|u_\epsilon(\cdot, t)\|_\infty + \|w_\epsilon(\cdot, t)\|_\infty) = \infty$.
